race.comment: Good race. Loved the return of DIRTY LOOK (12) at Sandown Hillside, heavily backed there and proving far too good from back in the field, coming away to score by two lengths. Suited to 1400m now and profiles as a mare who can measure up in some strong races. STAGE 'N' SCREEN (3) was just fair last time at Caulfield but had been a good winner in solid company at Flemington prior. Drawn wide but she can roll forward and give a sight. STUNG (9) resumes. She won two in a row to start last campaign including a Listed win. Drawn wide and likely to peak over further but look for her late. PUGLIA (10) has won three in a row and is impossible to knock. Up in the weights and apprentice on but is well placed.
